notes.amendment_2_inclusion: Amendment 2 governs the deployed narrow-readiness attestation contract and was resolved by the readiness implementation deployed at commit 7c2ca104. It is bound here so the governance chain is complete; the corpus countersignature itself is unchanged by it.
notes.embedded_countersignature_null: corpus_manifest_v2.json carries "countersignature": null and the construction-time status string "PROPOSED - NOT COUNTERSIGNED, NOT DEPLOYED". Those fields mean the construction artifact is not SELF-countersigned; they are stale construction-time metadata and do NOT mean governance approval is absent. This sidecar is the authoritative countersignature record. The embedded null can neither override this sidecar nor substitute for it.
notes.governance_document_digests: complete_package_sha256, amendment_1_sha256, amendment_2_sha256 and governance_record_sha256 are digests of the Windows-form (CRLF) bytes of the governance documents as recorded at countersignature time. A checkout with LF endings hashes differently (Amendment 1 LF form is bf1913b5962f3daad0cb4b079b80749ba099f072b27158d9fd99683c8cdbb21e). These are recorded governance references, not runtime-verified artifacts: the runtime verifies only that corpus_manifest_sha256 binds the exact loaded manifest.
notes.measurement_newline_clarification: The frozen replica identities were produced from the original Windows-form bytes. The deployed LF runtime is equivalent under the approved newline-normalized measurement identity (PATH_SORTED_SHA256_CRLF_TO_LF_V1); byte equality is separately governed by manifests/forward/measurement_bytes.json.
